This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.365/2022 registered at Police Station Bhalumada, District Anuppur, for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(cha), 376(3), 357, 294,
323 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4, 5(n) & 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
